items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: We had a jam session. Sheila Guys (?) sung. I sung.

ctx.x: So we toured all over. [ ] Cleveland, Ohio...Detroit, Michigan. We used to play ever'where... went ever' place. First time I was ever on a boat, I was on a boat with the band. We were travellin' up around...lessee, where were we now? We's up in Michigan some place, and we worked with...we had to travel

on a boat to get to the next date. They had a band on the boat so all the kids sat in on the band. We had a jam session. Sheila Guys (?) sung. I sung. An' the people gettin' paid for it, they sung. We had a ball. So I toured with them about two...three years all over the country. I ain't never been down South. I didn't know much about it, so that was my first shot down South. So we done all right down there. And then I met a lot of people down in Texas. I went over to Mississippi ...Tennessee...jus' all over the…
Did you hear any blues down there that you hadn't heard before?
